&nbsp;Job Position: Senior Mobile Engineer

Job Location: Remote
Employment Type: Full-time

Job Summary


	We are seeking a highly experienced and technically proficient Senior Mobile Engineer to design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain high-quality mobile applications across Android and/or iOS platforms.
	The successful candidate will work closely with Product, UI/UX, Backend, QA, and other engineering teams to translate business and product requirements into scalable, secure, reliable, and user-friendly mobile solutions.

Mobile Application Development:


	Design, develop, and maintain robust mobile applications for Android and/or iOS.
	Translate product requirements, wireframes, and technical specifications into functional mobile solutions.
	Write clean, maintainable, scalable, and well-documented code.
	Implement responsive and intuitive user interfaces in collaboration with UI/UX designers.
	Develop reusable components and establish coding standards and best practices.


Technical Architecture:


	Participate in defining and implementing mobile application architecture.
	Make appropriate technology and framework recommendations based on product requirements.
	Design solutions that support scalability, reliability, maintainability, and performance.
	Conduct technical reviews and contribute to architectural and engineering decisions.
	Identify technical debt and develop strategies for its resolution.


API &amp; Backend Integration:


	Integrate mobile applications with RESTful APIs, GraphQL, and other backend services.
	Work closely with backend engineers to define API requirements and resolve integration issues.
	Implement secure authentication, authorization, data handling, and API communication.
	Handle offline functionality, caching, synchronization, and error management where required.


Performance &amp; Security:


	Monitor and optimise application performance, memory usage, battery consumption, and network efficiency.
	Identify and resolve crashes, bugs, bottlenecks, and performance issues.
	Implement secure coding practices and protect sensitive user and business data.
	Ensure applications comply with relevant security and privacy requirements.


Testing &amp; Quality Assurance:


	Develop and maintain unit, integration, and UI tests.
	Collaborate with QA engineers to identify, reproduce, and resolve defects.
	Participate in code reviews and enforce quality standards.
	Ensure applications meet defined acceptance criteria before release.
	Conduct regression testing and support continuous quality improvement.


Deployment &amp; Release Management:


	Manage mobile application builds, releases, and deployment to relevant app stores.
	Work with DevOps and engineering teams to establish and maintain CI/CD pipelines.
	Manage application versioning and release documentation.
	Monitor production releases and respond promptly to critical issues.


Product Collaboration:


	Work closely with Product Managers to understand business objectives and technical requirements.
	Provide technical estimates, identify implementation risks, and contribute to product planning.
	Participate in Agile ceremonies including sprint planning, stand-ups, reviews, and retrospectives.
	Translate user and business needs into practical technical solutions.


Technical Leadership &amp; Mentorship:


	Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior and mid-level mobile engineers.
	Conduct and participate in peer code reviews.
	Promote engineering best practices, documentation, and knowledge sharing.
	Contribute to the continuous improvement of the engineering team&#39;s processes and standards.


Maintenance &amp; Continuous Improvement:


	Monitor applications after deployment and proactively identify areas for improvement.
	Implement new features, enhancements, bug fixes, and platform updates.
	Keep abreast of emerging mobile technologies, frameworks, tools, and industry best practices.
	Recommend improvements to existing applications and development processes.


Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
Performance will be measured against:


	Quality and reliability of mobile applications delivered.
	Timely delivery of assigned features and projects.
	Application crash and error rates.
	Mobile application performance and responsiveness.
	Defect rates and resolution turnaround time.
	Test coverage and code quality.
	Successful and stable production releases.
	API integration reliability.
	Security and compliance adherence.
	User experience and application performance metrics.
	Contribution to technical improvements and reduction of technical debt.
	Mentorship and knowledge-sharing within the engineering team.


Required Qualifications &amp; Experience


	Bachelor&#39;s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline.
	8+ years of professional experience in mobile application development, with significant experience delivering production applications.
	Strong experience with at least one major mobile development ecosystem:
	
		Android: Kotlin/Java, Android SDK, Jetpack/Compose.
		iOS: Swift/Objective-C, SwiftUI/UIKit.
		Cross-platform: Flutter/Dart or React Native/TypeScript.
	
	
	Proven experience taking mobile applications through the complete development lifecycle.
	Strong understanding of software development principles, design patterns, data structures, algorithms, and application architecture.
	Demonstrable experience integrating APIs and third-party services.
	Experience with Git and modern software development workflows.
	Experience with automated testing and CI/CD processes.
	Experience working within Agile/Scrum development environments.


Technical Competencies:
The successful candidate should demonstrate strong competence in:


	Mobile application architecture
	Kotlin/Java, Swift, Flutter/Dart, or React Native
	RESTful APIs and backend integration
	Git/GitHub/GitLab
	Firebase and/or equivalent mobile services
	Push notifications
	Authentication and authorization
	Local databases and data persistence
	Application performance optimisation
	Unit, integration, and UI testing
	CI/CD and automated deployment
	Crash monitoring and application analytics
	Secure mobile application development
	App Store and Google Play deployment.


Key Soft Skills:


	Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.
	Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
	Strong attention to detail.
	Ability to work independently and collaboratively.
	Strong ownership and accountability.
	Ability to manage competing priorities and meet deadlines.
	Commercial and product-oriented mindset.
	Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
	Strong mentoring and leadership capabilities.
	Continuous-learning mindset.


Salary
